settings.title: Gather the information needed for a real estimate
settings.text: Ask buyers for the intended room, target dimensions, use case, and any access constraints. That keeps the first conversation focused on scope instead of guesswork.
settings.feature_list:
Room type and installation location
Width, depth, and height targets
Reference images or sketches
Preferred wood species and finish
settings.callout_text:
Name
Email
Phone
ZIP code
Desired completion date

settings.title: Confirm materials, edge details, and final build scope
settings.text: Use this section to explain how revisions are handled, when drawings are approved, and what triggers production scheduling.
settings.feature_list:
Material and finish confirmation
Hardware selections if needed
Revision limits before deposit
Estimated lead time once approved
settings.callout_text: Clarify whether design changes after approval affect price or delivery date.

settings.title: Spell out how the order becomes a reserved build slot
settings.text: Customers should know when a quote expires, how deposits work, and what is included in delivery or installation.
settings.feature_list:
Written quote with scope summary
Deposit amount and payment timing
Delivery or install line items
Final balance due before or at delivery
settings.callout_text: Use the page body above this section for a short introduction or downloadable template text.

settings.heading: A clear custom order workflow builds trust before the first reply
settings.intro: Assign this template to a page named Custom Orders, then tailor each panel to the exact information you want buyers to submit before requesting a quote.
